title: uuencoding: missing #[must_use] on encode/decode/scan — inconsistent with yencoding
description: uuencoding/src/lib.rs — encode(), decode(), decode_limited(), and scan() all return values (Vec<u8> or Result/DecodedBlock) but none are marked #[must_use]. yencoding/src/lib.rs marks encode() and encode_part() with #[must_use]. The cross-crate inconsistency is a footgun: discarding a uuencoding::encode() return value produces no compiler warning. Fix: add #[must_use] to encode(), decode(), decode_limited(), and scan() in uuencoding/src/lib.rs.
close_reason: Added #[must_use] to encode() and scan() only; decode/decode_limited already return Result which is inherently must_use (clippy double_must_use)
